TRANSFORM.description: Revise, rewrite, shorten, expand, restyle, translate, polish, sharpen, soften, or otherwise edit the active artifact.

CONVERT.description: Change active content into a different artifact type.

ACTION.description: Deliver, send, forward, save, schedule, approve, deny, or otherwise act on active work without rewriting it.

CONTINUE.description: Advance a workflow step without changing active artifact content.
